name: Wakura Mayuko
source:
Mayuko, the foster mother of Isamu, embodies both beauty and serenity. She is a graceful widow who also happens to be the proprietor of a coffee house.

A decade ago, tragedy struck when her beloved husband was murdered. Overwhelmed by grief, Mayuko found herself teetering on the brink of despair. During this dark period, Isamu entered her life, saving her from the abyss and kindling a profound connection that would forever alter their fates. This event became a turning point in their relationship, ultimately leading to Mayuko taking Isamu away from the orphanage.

Having both experienced the loss of their loved ones, they find solace in one another, and their connection grows stronger with each passing day. She adores Isamu and considers him her own flesh and blood.

Nevertheless, she finds herself facing troubles as the recollections of her deceased spouse gradually diminish with each passing day...
